title: Carrier Takeover Guide: Crediting Prior-Carrier Accumulators to the Pharmacy Benefit Plan
content:
## Credit on takeover

Where the Pharmacy Benefit Plan design provides prior-carrier accumulator credit, the deductible and out-of-pocket the member met under a prior pharmacy carrier in the same plan year are credited once, as prior-carrier transfer postings dated the coverage effective date.

## Evidence

The credit is posted only from the prior carrier's accumulator statement and never from the member's own estimate.

## Statement deadline

The statement must be received no later than the design's prior-carrier statement window — a number of calendar days — after the coverage effective date, counted with the effective date as day zero; a statement received after that day is not credited. The effective date is read from the member's enrollment record, and the day the statement is received is compared with it; the last day of the window is itself on time.

## Limits

Amounts from a prior plan year, or exceeding this design's deductible or out-of-pocket maximum, are credited only up to those maximums.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical enrollment effective 1 March, window of 60 calendar days)

Counting 1 March as day zero, 31 March is day 30 and 30 April is day 60.

| Statement received | Day count | Credited |
|---|---|---|
| 1 March | Day 0 | Yes |
| 29 April | Day 59 | Yes |
| 30 April | Day 60, the last day of the window | Yes |
| 1 May | Day 61 | No |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A member's enrollment on a design with an individual deductible of 300.00 and an individual out-of-pocket maximum of 3000.00 becomes effective on 1 March. The prior carrier's statement, received on time, shows 500.00 of deductible and 1200.00 of out-of-pocket met earlier in the same plan year. The deductible is credited up to the design's 300.00; the out-of-pocket is credited at 1200.00, which is within the 3000.00 maximum. Both credits are posted once, dated 1 March. Had the member only given an estimate by phone, with no statement from the prior carrier, nothing would be credited.

## Points of judgement

- Source of the figures: the prior carrier's statement only.
- Number of credits: once.
- Date of the postings: the coverage effective date.
- Deadline: no later than the window's last day, counting the effective date as day zero.
